summary: Blue Owl Credit Income Corp., a listed BDC, completed a private placement of $700 million 6.250% notes due 2029 and $300 million 6.550% notes due 2031 on September 14, 2026, under a September 9 purchase agreement with initial purchasers led by Goldman Sachs, BofA, MUFG, Scotia and SMBC Nikko. Net proceeds of roughly $988.1 million, after about $3.0 million of fees and expenses, will repay borrowings under its senior secured revolver maturing October 18, 2029, its 3.125% September 2026 notes maturing September 23, 2026, and/or other secured facilities. This is a routine debt capital-raising and refinancing, not a special situation; no equity terms, premium, board recommendation or advisor fairness opinion are stated. Watch liability management and maturity-ladder risk.
